verses.en: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. A Psalm of David.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David.

verses.he: יְהוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מָֽה־אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥ה הֹ֝ודְךָ֗ עַל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.ar: أَيُّهَا ٱلرَّبُّ سَيِّدُنَا، مَا أَمْجَدَ ٱسْمَكَ فِي كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ! حَيْثُ جَعَلْتَ جَلَالَكَ فَوْقَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ.
verses.en: O LORD, our Lord, how glorious is Thy name in all the earth! whose majesty is rehearsed above the heavens.
verses.kjv: O LORD our Lord, how excellent [is] thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
verses.web: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

verses.he: מִפִּ֤י עֹֽולְלִ֨ים ׀ וְֽיֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֪דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צֹורְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית אֹ֝ויֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃
verses.ar: مِنْ أَفْوَاهِ ٱلْأَطْفَالِ وَٱلرُّضَّعِ أَسَّسْتَ حَمْدًا بِسَبَبِ أَضْدَادِكَ، لِتَسْكِيتِ عَدُوٍّ وَمُنْتَقِمٍ.
verses.en: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast Thou founded strength, because of Thine adversaries; that Thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.kjv: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.web: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

verses.he: כִּֽי־אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝כֹוכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כֹּונָֽנְתָּה׃
verses.ar: إِذَا أَرَى سَمَاوَاتِكَ عَمَلَ أَصَابِعِكَ، ٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ ٱلَّتِي كَوَّنْتَهَا،
verses.en: When I behold Thy heavens, the work of Thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which Thou hast established;
verses.kjv: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
verses.web: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

verses.ar: فَمَنْ هُوَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ حَتَّى تَذْكُرَهُ؟ وَٱبْنُ آدَمَ حَتَّى تَفْتَقِدَهُ؟
verses.en: What is man, that Thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that Thou thinkest of him?
verses.kjv: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.web: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

verses.he: וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָבֹ֖וד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.ar: وَتَنْقُصَهُ قَلِيلًا عَنِ ٱلْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَبِمَجْدٍ وَبَهَاءٍ تُكَلِّلُهُ.
verses.en: Yet Thou hast made him but little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.kjv: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.web: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

verses.he: תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת־רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.ar: تُسَلِّطُهُ عَلَى أَعْمَالِ يَدَيْكَ. جَعَلْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ تَحْتَ قَدَمَيْهِ:
verses.en: Thou hast made him to have dominion over the works of Thy hands; Thou hast put all things under His feet:
verses.kjv: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all [things] under his feet:
verses.web: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

verses.he: צֹנֶ֣ה וַאֲלָפִ֣ים כֻּלָּ֑ם וְ֝גַ֗ם בַּהֲמֹ֥ות שָׂדָֽי׃
verses.ar: ٱلْغَنَمَ وَٱلْبَقَرَ جَمِيعًا، وَبَهَائِمَ ٱلْبَرِّ أَيْضًا،
verses.en: Sheep and oxen, all of them, yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.kjv: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.web: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

verses.he: צִפֹּ֣ור שָׁ֭מַיִם וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם עֹ֝בֵ֗ר אָרְחֹ֥ות יַמִּֽים׃
verses.ar: وَطُيُورَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ، وَسَمَكَ ٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلسَّالِكَ فِي سُبُلِ ٱلْمِيَاهِ.
verses.en: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea; whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.kjv: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, [and whatsoever] passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.web: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

verses.ar: أَيُّهَا ٱلرَّبُّ سَيِّدُنَا، مَا أَمْجَدَ ٱسْمَكَ فِي كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ!
verses.en: O LORD, our Lord, how glorious is Thy name in all the earth!
verses.kjv: O LORD our Lord, how excellent [is] thy name in all the earth!
verses.web: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
